name: Why is plumbing and electrical coordination important for a home addition?
description: Coordination ensures safety, functionality, and compliance with local building codes, preventing conflicts and costly delays in your home addition.

mainEntity.name: Why is plumbing and electrical coordination important for a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper coordination of plumbing and electrical systems is critical for safety, functionality, and compliance with local building codes in areas like Berkeley and Oakland. Without careful planning, conflicts can arise between pipes and wires, leading to costly rerouting, delays, and potential safety hazards. It also ensures that fixtures and appliances are powered and drained efficiently, contributing to the long-term integrity and usability of your new space.
